scope: Historical action-head restore and live standalone MiniMax-H3 INT8 rollout on node 30234

contracts.historical_context: refined H3 multimodal context [1,113|115,5376] with matching token_tags

root_causes.name: timestep_domain_inversion
root_causes.evidence: Comfy receives sigma=1000 and internally computes t_video=1-sigma/1000=0; the first native cache incorrectly used curve timestep 1.0.

root_causes.name: historical_in_place_capture_alias
root_causes.evidence: All five stored historical layer tensors are exactly equal for task0, task3, and push-plate (max_abs_difference=0). The old hook detached but did not clone an in-place-mutated Comfy hidden tensor, so all selected layers became final-layer features.

task3_h1_video_lora_reference_early_diag.contract_note: This early diagnostic accidentally compared against an H1 video-LoRA feature file. It is retained only as audit history and is not the restored rollout contract.

task3_h8_video_lora_reference_corrected.contract_note: This is the matching H8 reference used to gate the real rollout. The successful rollout used action_horizon=8, feature_audio_horizon=8, the historical video LoRA, the H8 recovery head, and the learned_switch gate.

online_provider_parity.comparison: standalone online provider output versus corrected offline comfy_alias_v1 H8 cache

non_policy_failures.resolution: Replaced import of the broad official encoders module with a standalone source-audited VAE helper.
Installed project-locked accelerate==1.12.0 and psutil into /mnt/h3-wam/runtime/h3-int8-native only; saved install log and before/after freeze.
Removed the exact SIM_SITE_PACKAGES entry only from the policy child PYTHONPATH. Exact-env smoke loaded NumPy 2.4.6 and accelerate 1.12.0 from the isolated policy venv and loaded the official VAE.
Bound torch current_device to the configured policy device before comfy_kitchen DLPack calls; reran the same trial and seed.

task0.contract: historical base plus fixed switch to recovery head at step 64

task3.contract: H8 base plus H8 recovery, video LoRA, and learned_switch threshold 0.1

r0_30_episode_regression.protocol: Existing fixed trial0 plus trial indices 1-9 for each task; seed=42; no replacement trials or alternate seeds

task0.failure_summary: Both failures moved the bowl/plate substantially while the requested middle drawer stayed closed, indicating wrong-object motion rather than a static policy.

task3.failure_summary: Trials 4 and 6 moved the plate instead of the bowl/drawer; trial 7 opened the correct top drawer by 0.13688 but did not place the bowl, exposing object selection and multi-stage completion failures.

push_plate.failure_summary: All failures moved the plate (0.16883-0.24275 joint delta) but did not reach the success region, indicating endpoint/control robustness rather than no-action collapse.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=src /mnt/h3-wam/runtime/h3-int8-native/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_policy_environment.py tests/test_h3_int8_online.py tests/test_h3wam_lora.py tests/test_h3wam_int8_backbone.py tests/test_h3_int8_precompute.py

decision.reason: The restored standalone online path exactly matches its corrected offline provider output and all three fixed canaries passed, so the H3 INT8 deployment contract is valid. The frozen 30-episode regression reached only 22/30 (73.33%), below the preregistered 26/30 gate; therefore the current historical action system is not robust enough to claim a stable R0 policy.
decision.next_gate: Do not tune the provider contract or add replacement seeds. Preserve the exact provider and focus the next action-learning experiment on object/task grounding, multi-stage completion, and endpoint robustness, then evaluate on the same frozen 30-trial protocol.
